revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Painting a Bedroom
revealWordProblem.text: Tahira is planning to paint the walls of her bedroom, which is in the shape of a rectangular prism 12 ft long, 10 ft wide, and 8 ft tall. She will not paint the floor or ceiling. The room has one window (3 ft by 4 ft) and two doors (each 3 ft by 7 ft) that will not be painted. How many square feet of wall does Tahira need to paint?
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Wall area = perimeter × height = 2(12 + 10) × 8 = 44 × 8 = 352 ft². Subtract the openings: window = 3 × 4 = 12 ft²; two doors = 2 × (3 × 7) = 42 ft². Paintable area = 352 − 12 − 42 = 298 ft².

conceptIntro.heading: Determine Surface Area of Prisms
conceptIntro.intro: To find the surface area of a prism, find the area of every face. Then add them all.

conceptIntro.keyIdea: The surface area of any prism is the sum of the areas of all its faces: 6 faces for a rectangular prism, 5 for a triangular prism.

iDo.title: Example · A triangular prism
lines: A triangular prism is 10 in long. Each triangle end has a base of 6 in and a height of 4 in. The two slanted sides are 5 in each. Find the surface area.
Count the faces: 2 triangles and 3 rectangles
Find the area of the two triangles: 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12; 2 × 12 = 24
Find the area of the three rectangles: 6 × 10 = 60; 5 × 10 = 50; 5 × 10 = 50
Add the triangles and the rectangles: 24 + 160 = 184
The surface area is 184 square inches.
linesEs: Un prisma triangular mide 10 pulg de largo. Cada triángulo de los extremos tiene una base de 6 pulg y una altura de 4 pulg. Los dos lados inclinados miden 5 pulg cada uno. Halla el área de superficie.
Cuenta las caras: 2 triángulos y 3 rectángulos
Halla el área de los dos triángulos: 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12; 2 × 12 = 24
Halla el área de los tres rectángulos: 6 × 10 = 60; 5 × 10 = 50; 5 × 10 = 50
Suma los triángulos y los rectángulos: 24 + 160 = 184
El área de superficie es 184 pulgadas cuadradas.

weDo.title: Let's do one together
lines: A rectangular prism is 5 cm long, 4 cm wide, and 3 cm tall. Find its surface area.
How many faces does a rectangular prism have? (6 faces, in 3 matching pairs)
Find the top and bottom together. (5 × 4 = 20, and 2 × 20 = 40)
Find the front and back together. (5 × 3 = 15, and 2 × 15 = 30)
Find the left and right together. (4 × 3 = 12, and 2 × 12 = 24)
Add the three pairs. What is the surface area? (40 + 30 + 24 = 94 square centimeters)
linesEs: Un prisma rectangular mide 5 cm de largo, 4 cm de ancho y 3 cm de alto. Halla su área de superficie.
¿Cuántas caras tiene un prisma rectangular? (6 caras, en 3 pares iguales)
Halla la cara de arriba y la de abajo juntas. (5 × 4 = 20, y 2 × 20 = 40)
Halla el frente y la de atrás juntas. (5 × 3 = 15, y 2 × 15 = 30)
Halla la izquierda y la derecha juntas. (4 × 3 = 12, y 2 × 12 = 24)
Suma los tres pares. ¿Cuál es el área de superficie? (40 + 30 + 24 = 94 centímetros cuadrados)

onLevel.titleEs: Descubre el error común — ¿área de superficie o volumen?

practice.commonMistake: A common mistake in Surface Area of Prisms is confusing surface area with volume — multiplying l × w × h (which finds the space INSIDE the prism, in cubic units) instead of adding the areas of all the faces (SA = 2lw + 2lh + 2wh, in square units).
